verdict.rationale: Cline docs mention building 'AI agents and integrations powered by the same core engine' behind its CLI/Kanban/IDE plugins, implying an SDK-like foundation, but there's no actual SDK package, API reference, or code samples, and a probe for OpenAPI/schema docs returned 404s across all candidate paths. missing for 10: published SDK package/reference docs, code samples for building against the engine, independent evidence of third-party integrations built with it.
